title: Graduate Program - Engineering (civil stream)
location: Tasmania (induction); streams also referenced for QLD/NSW operations
content_text:
Graduate Programs - Hazell Bros
Just graduated or about to finish your studies? Our graduate program is built to help you kickstart your career.
Engineering stream: Whether you have studied mechanical, marine or civil engineering we want to hear from you! Rotations could include Asset Management, Quarries, Laboratory Testing and Civil engineering.
About You: Genuine interest; willingness to learn; strong safety focus; communication; team or independent; Current Drivers Licence (or Provisional at minimum) for engineering graduates.
Application process: complete application including resume, cover letter and academic transcript; reviewed by Careers team; pre-screening; interview with hiring manager.
FAQ: Candidates with degrees from Australian Universities only relevant to the role will be considered.
Do you accept applications from international students? Yes, however, you must have either Permanent Residency or a VISA with full time working rights that is valid for the duration of the program, with degree completion at an Australian university.
Contact: careers@hazellbros.com.au for information. Page note on Site Engineer vacancy: applications sent to careers@ email will not be considered (apply via portal). Graduate program applications go through the graduate pathway / vacancies process.
Vacancies board also lists Site Engineer Gold Coast (2+ years experience, Bachelor of Civil Engineering or equivalent) closing 21/10/2026 - separate from graduate program.
apply_instructions: Apply via Hazell Bros graduate program / careers vacancies portal with resume, cover letter and transcript. Do not email applications to careers@hazellbros.com.au (info only).
